title: Toward Global Large Language Models in Medicine
abstract: arXiv:2601.02186v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite continuous advances in medical technology, the global distribution of health care resources remains uneven. The development of large language models (LLMs) has transformed the landscape of medicine and holds promise for improving health care quality and expanding access to medical information globally. However, existing LLMs are primarily trained on high-resource languages, limiting their applicability in global medical scenarios. To address this gap, we constructed GlobMed, a large multilingual medical dataset containing more than 800,000 entries spanning 20 languages, including seven low-resource languages. Building on this, we established GlobMed-Bench, which systematically assesses 56 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs across 12 of the 20 languages represented in GlobMed, comprising over 20,000 independent experiments and more than 32 million model responses. translated_title: 迈向全球化的医学大语言模型
translated_abstract: 尽管医疗技术不断进步，但全球医疗资源的分布仍然不均。大语言模型的发展已经改变了医学领域的格局，并有望提高医疗质量、在全球范围内扩大医疗信息的获取渠道。然而，现有的LLM主要基于高资源语言进行训练，这限制了它们在全球医疗场景中的适用性。为了解决这一差距，我们构建了GlobMed，这是一个包含超过80万条数据、涵盖20种语言（包括7种低资源语言）的大型多语言医学数据集。在此基础上，我们建立了GlobMed-Bench，系统性地评估了56个最先进的专有和开放权重LLM，涉及GlobMed中20种语言中的12种，包含超过2万个独立实验和超过3200万条模型响应。这一大规模评估揭示了显著的（性能差异）
tldr: 本研究构建了包含20种语言的80万条医学数据集GlobMed及基准测试GlobMed-Bench，对56个先进大语言模型进行大规模评估，揭示了现有模型因依赖高资源语言训练而在全球医疗场景中的局限性。
en_tdlr: This study constructed GlobMed, a large multilingual medical dataset spanning 20 languages with 800,000 entries, and established GlobMed-Bench to systematically evaluate 56 state-of-the-art LLMs, revealing significant limitations of existing models in global medical scenarios due to their training on high-resource languages.
